name: modrixcommerce/voltmarket
description: A yellow-accent marketplace with campaign mosaics, compact product shelves, sidebar filtering and a three-column product page. Built with the native live section editor; customize fonts, colors, navigation, footer and every section.
author: Modrix team

changelog.notes: Uses Admin → Navigation menus (top, departments, mobile, footer) once saved; header and footer get a Menus setting.
The sticky header turns compact while scrolling (logo, search and icons only), with an on/off setting in the live Header section.
Theme-native sticky header on desktop and mobile, with an on/off setting in the live Header section. Announcement banners scroll away; mobile navigation and module actions stay available.
Mobile-only fixed navigation with separate menu, expandable category and search panels, live cart count, and editable labels and accent color.
New marketplace theme created with MagicPath; native section editor and platform shopping flows.
